title: SQL query built by string concatenation with user input
message: User-controlled 'customerId' is concatenated directly into a SQL command.
code:
string sql = "SELECT * FROM Customers WHERE Id = '" + Request["customerId"] + "'";
var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn);

title: Reflected XSS via Response.Write of unencoded input
message: Request parameter 'q' is written to the response without encoding.

title: Weak hashing algorithm (MD5) used for passwords
message: MD5 is used to hash credentials; it is not collision-resistant.

title: SQL built by concatenation in a test fixture
message: Raw SQL concatenation detected inside a unit-test helper.
code: var sql = "INSERT INTO Customers (Name) VALUES ('" + name + "')"; // test seed

title: Possible API key in sample config
message: A high-entropy string that looks like an API key was found.

title: Vulnerable dependency: Newtonsoft.Json (deserialization DoS)
message: Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1 is affected by CVE-2024-21907; fixed in 13.0.1.
